And people loved it.

title: The device that removed choice

author: Slidebean
description:
Google changed the deal

Google built the web on one promise:
Create content → get traffic.

Now that’s changing.

With AI Overviews, Google reads multiple sources, summarizes them, and shows the answer directly, no clicks needed.

The impact is already visible:
• Clicks down: 42%
• Mobile searches: 77% end without a click

The twist?
AI is trained on the same content it’s now replacing.

Publishers built the system.
Now they’re being cut out of it.

title: Google doesn’t need your clicks anymore
